comparison.objective: Hand-guide a carriage to two points while enabling a plunger in its middle band, versus tune a carriage damper through impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Carriage translation plus sustained plunger positioning versus hex-key unlocking, collar tuning, relocking, and iterative dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Available text requires reaching two points with the plunger held in-band; numeric point/band/scoring details are missing. Candidate requires two ≥0.85 J safe stops and witness-tested retention.
comparison.reason: A carriage is shared, but hand-guided positioning with a held enable device does not test damper adjustment or stopping dynamics.
